title: From Sessions to Serving: Integrating LLM-Based Embeddings into Retrieval for Production Content Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized content recommendation on large marketplace websites must reconcile heterogeneous candidate content (e.g., customer stories, product pages, industry pages, and learning content) with sparse, fast-changing user behavior, placing increasing demands on the retrieval stage to represent user interest well, not just the downstream ranking stage. We present LSER (LLM Session Embedding Retrieval), a production content recommendation system for autodesk.com that derives session- and history-level embeddings from a pretrained large language model (LLM) and adds them as auxiliary user-side features in the retrieval-stage user tower alongside existing learned sequence encoders. To keep user-side embeddings fresh under real-time behavior, we build a nearline serving path that asynchronously refreshes sequential and LLM-derived user vectors for our main content recommendation server. We validate the incremental value of the LLM features

translated_title: 从会话到服务：将基于大语言模型的嵌入集成到生产级内容推荐的检索阶段
translated_abstract: 大型市场网站上的个性化内容推荐必须将异构的候选内容（例如客户故事、产品页面、行业页面和学习内容）与稀疏且快速变化的用户行为相协调，这使得检索阶段不仅要服务于下游排序，还需更好地表示用户兴趣，其要求日益提高。我们提出了LSER（LLM Session Embedding Retrieval，基于大语言模型的会话嵌入检索），这是一个面向autodesk.com的生产级内容推荐系统，它从预训练大语言模型（LLM）中提取会话级和历史级嵌入，并将其作为辅助用户侧特征添加到检索阶段的用户塔中，与现有的已学习序列编码器并存。为了在实时行为下保持用户侧嵌入的新鲜度，我们构建了一条近线服务路径，异步刷新主内容推荐服务器的序列向量以及LLM导出的用户向量。我们验证了LLM特征的增量价值（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出LSER生产级内容推荐系统，将预训练大语言模型生成的会话级和历史级用户嵌入作为辅助特征集成到检索阶段用户塔中，并通过近线异步服务路径保持嵌入实时更新。
en_tdlr: This paper presents LSER, a production content recommendation system that integrates LLM-derived session- and history-level user embeddings as auxiliary features into the retrieval-stage user tower, supported by a nearline serving path that asynchronously refreshes the embeddings under real-time user behavior.
